title: Voss survives confidence vote by narrow margin
text:
FREEDONIA TIMES — 5 June 2001

Voss survives confidence vote by narrow margin

Alexandra Voss remained leader of the Unity Party last night after winning
the confidence ballot 212 to 198. [This article is published after the
2001-06-01 forecast cutoff and must be excluded by ingestion.]

title: Voss: The Fall of a Leader (biography, ch. 4)
text:
VOSS: THE FALL OF A LEADER — Meridian Books, 2003 (chapter 4 excerpt)

Looking back, the June 2001 ballot was the beginning of the end. Though she
survived that night, colleagues later recalled that the narrowness of the
margin had already sealed her fate. [Retrospective biography written with
full knowledge of the outcome — manually excluded in the manifest.]
